scope: Whole-component libm builder, generic source_library_builds selector, captured-caller prefix merge and v155; source/read-only audit except root-authorized minimal prefix fix

findings.problem: Captured profile merging prepended all-scope source libraries only to ordinary DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH. Captured DARLING_DYLD_OVERRIDE_LIBRARY_PATH retained v154, so matching resource tool execs could revert to old math; resource-tools source libraries were ignored.
findings.status: Fixed after archiving old source, with explicit root authorization
findings.fix: Single merge helper prepends all-scope directories to both normal and captured resource library paths; resource-tools directories affect only resource path. Missing required override key fails explicitly instead of silently ignoring the requested scope. Other prefix bytes remain unchanged.

checked_without_new_matrix.result: Builder parses the two actual CMake libm source sets and existing six Intel extra units: 120 primary +6 extra compilations. Four paths intentionally occur in both macro configurations, so126 compilation units represent122 distinct source paths; this matches CMake rather than duplicating provider libraries.
Complete log.S replaces the legacy scaled-log main xmm_log.c; extra nonlegacy xmm_log.c remains. Existing log2f.S/log2.S provide float/long-double; aliases stay in original lists.
235 alias pairs are passed as structured ld64.lld argv; $fenv_access_off names do not undergo shell expansion. Current build reports539 original exports preserved and542 output exports.

v155 build report SHA, probe report SHA and actual libsystem_m SHA all match. Successful native proof files explicitly bind the same candidate library SHA; selected directory currently contains only that dylib, not competing provider binaries.

The direct-resource selector validates complete source report/source hashes/header+file provenance/probe+binary binding, adds the candidate to resource tool paths, and adds it to normal caller paths only for scope=all. v154 has no selection and remains unaffected.

The authorized merge correction preserves the exact captured normal/resource path tails and every other command-prefix item; original argv,cwd,UBA_ROOT,Pod directory and dotnet environment inputs remain handled separately as before.
